policy_definitions.current: lowest decayed route hotness, then oldest cache use
policy_definitions.least_stale_layer_fifo: demand-only layer-FIFO variant inspired by least-stale: stale before current-cycle residents, ascending layer, FIFO; all initial residents stale, FIFO seeded by last_used; includes stale-right fallback; no prefetch; not a paper reproduction
policy_definitions.oracle: farthest next route use within the finite trace

metric_semantics.pread_bytes: logical requested expert bytes, not physical SSD traffic
metric_semantics.hit_rate: simulated expert hit fraction; no throughput prediction
metric_semantics.pread_ms: observed blocking worker-read batch wall time
metric_semantics.load_ms: observed synchronous load wall time including preparation/install
metric_semantics.reductions: same initial resident state, budget, and routing; versus audited current
